topic: New analytics version deployment and features
summary_markdown:
A new version of the analytics platform was deployed to production, making it live. Key changes include an upgraded design, mall updates, and user management functionality.

The primary focus is that the analytics now function on mobile devices, a feature developed over 2.5 years.
Additionally, dwell-time tracking for malls begins this night (with one exception noted).
decisions: The new analytics version has been deployed to production.
